name: Succu!!
source:
Piano is a naturally well endowed girl who is ordered around by her beautiful and highly intelligent elder sister, Seraphine.
Together with Miluse, their cat-eared robot who acts as their watchdog, they set off on a trip through medieval Japan!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034307.html]DLsite English[/url]]
